payload.core_mechanism_summary: Loop over integer x1, compute integer y1 satisfying x1²+y1²=a², then construct perpendicular integer vector of length b from gcd, checking non-axis-aligned condition.
payload.rationale: Algorithm enforces integer coordinates by exhaustive search over possible leg vectors; candidate 'search_backtracking' is closest, as it tests each x1 and breaks on success, though lacks recursion.
